en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large, ornate early‑20th‑century university building on a broad, mostly empty street. The multi‑storey structure has tall rectangular windows, a stone base, decorative window frames, and a central section with a tower-like element and steep tiled roofs. The style is Central European, and printed Hungarian text appears in the lower margin.
